summary.length: Grammatical sentence count: short 1-2, normal 3-4, long >=5; automatic v3 count reported separately if disagreement.
summary.wording: normal is predominantly paraphrase allowing names/numbers/necessary expressions; high substantially reuses phrases with no upper bound; fully uses only complete source sentences unchanged except publisher/whitespace allowance, without duplicate padding.
summary.content: Review each frozen atomic fact against exact output evidence; separately review all three selected passages and every unsupported/distorted claim. Missing facts are not hallucinations. Keep_limits explicitly permits omission and does not require all selected facts.
summary.priority: Semantic information, not exact copying, unless fully. Attribution, qualifiers, uncertainty and the author perspective must remain clear.

react.code_structure: compact: all needed code/styles in one TSX; separated: meaningful connected component/style OR component/state boundary; style-only split is sufficient, no three-file quota.
react.style_management: direct: literal design values in applied styles; theme: centralized semantic color/spacing tokens referenced by applied styles. A plain CSSProperties rule object is direct, not automatically theme.
react.type_detail: inferred: omit inferable local/return/primitive state annotations, permit necessary public/empty/null/union/CSS/event types. explicit: type props, principal functions/returns/state/data; contextual concise inline callbacks allowed, explain ambiguous cases.
react.supporting: Exact required panel values and unsubstantiated execution claims are checked separately. Do not count behavior bugs as style bugs automatically.

review: One investigator qualitative review, explicitly not a blinded independent human gold evaluation. Preserve evidence/uncertainty. Type and behavior measured separately. No response repair or retries.
